crossRefs.note: Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise…
Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with…
For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t…
envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that…
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

translations.web: Don’t you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?
translations.bsb: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
translations.kjv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
translations.asv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
